connector.name: Growthbook MCP
connector.registryDescription: Thin MCP server for GrowthBook - skill loader + authenticated API passthrough
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the growthbook account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GB_API_KEY
env.description: A GrowthBook API key or personal access token.

env.name: GB_API_URL
env.description: Your GrowthBook API URL. Defaults to https://api.growthbook.io.

env.name: GB_SKILLS_ENABLED
env.description: Set to false to disable bundled skill tools (growthbook_list_skills, growthbook_read_skill). Defaults to true.

env.name: GB_HTTP_HEADER_*
env.description: Custom HTTP headers via GB_HTTP_HEADER_<NAME> (e.g. GB_HTTP_HEADER_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN).
